q: The concept of mixing (strong mixing) for a measure-preserving system means:
opts: μ(T⁻ⁿA ∩ B) → μ(A)μ(B) for all measurable A, B
exp: Strong mixing: sets become asymptotically independent under iteration. This is strictly stronger than ergodicity (which only requires Cesàro convergence of μ(T⁻ⁿA ∩ B)).
